title: artist: A Python package for differentiable ray tracing and gradient-based optimization of solar tower power plant operation
abstract: arXiv:2611.20851v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Solar tower power plants provide dispatchable, renewable energy by concentrating sunlight with thousands of mirrors, called heliostats, onto a central receiver. Efficient operation requires accurate modeling of the optical path from each heliostat to the receiver and compensation for manufacturing imperfections, kinematic misalignment, and material degradation that distort the flux distribution. Conventional ray tracers predict the flux from an assumed plant model but are limited to forward simulation. They cannot recover unknown plant parameters from measured flux nor directly optimize plant operation. We present artist, an open-source, FAIR4RS-compliant Python package implementing a fully differentiable digital twin of solar tower power plants. By making the optical pipeline, comprising heliostat surface representation, kinematics, blocking, and ray tracing, end to end differentiable, artist turns the digital twin from a passive forwar

translated_title: artist：一个用于塔式太阳能热发电站运行的可微分光线追踪与基于梯度优化的 Python 软件包
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.20851v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：塔式太阳能热发电站通过将数千面称为定日镜的反射镜所汇聚的阳光集中到中央接收器上，提供可调度的可再生能源。高效的电站运行需要对从每面定日镜到接收器的光路进行精确建模，并补偿制造缺陷、运动学失准以及材料老化所引起的能流分布畸变。传统光线追踪器基于假定的电站模型预测能流分布，但仅限于正向仿真：它们既无法从实测能流中恢复未知的电站参数，也无法直接优化电站运行。我们提出了 artist，一个开源的、符合 FAIR4RS 标准的 Python 软件包，实现了塔式太阳能热发电站的全可微分数字孪生。通过使光学流水线——包括定日镜表面表示、运动学、遮挡效应和光线追踪——实现端到端可微分，artist 使数字孪生从被动的正向仿真工具转变为……
tldr: artist 通过将塔式太阳能电站的光学流水线（定日镜表面、运动学、遮挡与光线追踪）实现端到端可微分，构建了全可微分的数字孪生，从而支持从实测能流中反演未知电站参数并基于梯度优化电站运行。
en_tdlr: artist is an open-source Python package providing a fully differentiable digital twin of solar tower power plants, enabling gradient-based optimization of plant operation and recovery of unknown plant parameters from measured flux.
